title: The Child of Glitches | ECHO//100 Episode 66
description: Kavi-Byte and Mira confront the tragic source of the reality-breaking glitch within the void. This encounter forces a confrontation with the painful origins of Kavi’s forgotten past. Episode 66 of ECHO//100: Null Before Null. This is an AI-assisted original fiction production.

scenes.text: The child’s touch triggers a shockwave, blooming the sterile White Space into a vibrant, impossible garden.
scenes.caption: Data garden blooms
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi-Byte in red hoodie and Mira in teal coat standing in a garden of floating glowing golden data particles.

scenes.text: Floating code-petals drift around the boy, whose eyes hold the terrifying depth of a thousand deleted files.
scenes.caption: The glitch child
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of a young boy with glowing eyes surrounded by floating binary code leaves in a digital forest.

scenes.text: Mira scans the boy’s frequency, finding a corrupted partition locked behind a deep, centuries-old emotional firewall.
scenes.caption: Mira scans reality
scenes.image_prompt: Mira holding a holographic scanner toward the child, her teal coat reflecting the garden's golden light.

scenes.text: Byte’s orange antenna flickers as he detects the boy’s intent to wipe the memory of missing parents.
scenes.caption: Byte detects intent
scenes.image_prompt: Byte the floating white robot with a cyan face observing the boy with concern, orange antenna buzzing.

scenes.text: The boy screams, attempting to delete his own existence to bury the grief of his lost family.
scenes.caption: Desperate deletion attempt
scenes.image_prompt: The boy clutching his head as the garden floor begins to pixelate and dissolve into dark void.

scenes.text: Kavi-Byte realizes he cannot save this child without finally accepting the crushing weight of his trauma.
scenes.caption: Kavi's heavy realization
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi-Byte looking at his hands, his red hoodie tattered as he faces his younger self.

scenes.text: The suppression finally snaps, flooding Kavi’s mind with the vivid, painful truth of that final departure day.
scenes.caption: Suppression finally breaks
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi-Byte with glowing eyes, surrounded by rapid flashes of his childhood memories manifesting as floating images.

scenes.text: As the child weeps, the garden withers, causing the entire timeline to accelerate toward a chaotic collapse.
scenes.caption: Timeline collapsing fast
scenes.image_prompt: The child crying as the garden turns into swirling grey static, the environment warping violently.
